references.text: Earlier in the chapter, the two braided chains of gold that are to be attached to the breastplate are described.
Describes the two gold rings that are to be fastened at the corners of the breastplate, through which the chains are to be threaded.
The fulfillment of this instruction when the breastplate was actually made with the gold chains attached to the rings.
The introduction of the breastplate (חֹשֶׁן) to which the chains are to be attached.
This is the direct continuation showing that the instruction to attach the cords was followed exactly.
A complementary verse describing the other part of the fastening mechanism on the breastplate.
